func TestAFailedSeatHoldsTheGroupUntilTheRollback(t *testing.T) {
	store, _, fence := testStore(t)
	c := newCell(t)
	controller := c.controller(store, fence)
	c.release(2)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.backends["10.251.0.21:9465"] = Backend{Drained: true}
	c.now = c.now.Add(DefaultDrainGrace)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.state["gru-1-db-1"] = "failed"
	for range 5 {
		c.now = c.now.Add(time.Minute)
		c.tick(controller)
	}
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})

	c.release(3)
	c.state["gru-1-db-1"] = "failed"
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})
	c.state["gru-1-db-1"] = "running"
	c.tick(controller)
	c.now = c.now.Add(DefaultSettle)
	c.tick(controller)
	// Its host reports it serving, but the load balancer has not found it
	// healthy yet: it stays drained.
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})
	// Once it does, the seat settles and returns.
	c.backends["10.251.0.21:9465"] = Backend{Drained: true, Healthy: true}
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})
	c.now = c.now.Add(DefaultSettle)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, nil, []string{"gru-1-db-1"})
}

func TestAHoldStartsNoSeatRestart(t *testing.T) {
	store, _, fence := testStore(t)
	c := newCell(t)
	controller := c.controller(store, fence)
	reason := "orchestrator host rollout release-g2-hosts"
	controller.Hold = func(context.Context) (string, error) { return reason, nil }
	c.release(2)
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, nil, nil)
	reason = ""
	c.tick(controller)
	c.expect(store, []string{"gru-1-db-1"}, nil)
}

scope.label: Real detached process admission and cleanup through shell fixtures
scope.qualification_limit: The shell fixture substitutes systemctl. Observation is injected and checks real pid marker and /proc; this does not exercise systemd scope ownership or actual cgroup admission.

operator.label: Operator JSON through a real bounded command
operator.qualification_limit: Shell/cat fixture produces malformed arrays. No SSH, real operator API or host inventory service is contacted.

restore.label: Held descriptor error followed by fresh-path identity and existing-cap verification
restore.qualification_limit: Regular files and real descriptors substitute cgroup control files; no kernel cgroup memory cap is changed.

inventory.label: Real child and /proc identity with synthetic cgroup.procs
inventory.qualification_limit: sleep child and procfs are real. The cgroup inventory directory is synthetic and does not prove kernel cgroup membership enforcement.

io.label: Finite worker bytes with real file creation and fdatasync
io.qualification_limit: Actual regular-file writes/stat support the count and finite-byte assertions. No production disk pressure, filesystem performance or cgroup I/O enforcement is qualified.

journal.label: Real journal command transport and malformed-record filtering
journal.qualification_limit: cat fixture supplies journal records; no live systemd journal or OOM event is produced.

block.label: Mount and sysfs evidence from real filesystem fixtures
block.qualification_limit: The file/symlink reads and evidence reload support device assertions. mountinfo/sysfs and device numbers are fixture data; no physical device or real mounted workload is qualified.

manifest.label: Reexecuted CLI rejects manifest before resource execution
manifest.qualification_limit: Real subprocess and manifest read are material to CLI error/exit and no-worker-file assertions. Validation returns before cgroup admission or resource workload; no pressure execution credited.

pinned.label: Held executable inode reused after pathname replacement
pinned.qualification_limit: Actual test-binary fd reexec is asserted by its marker. Child-only fixture root itself has no assertion and remains unresolved.

state.label: Canonical bounded state persistence and protected-file readback
state.qualification_limit: Regular-file write/fsync/rename/readback. Oversize and symlink rejection also read retained/protected bytes; these are material safety assertions, not separate independent pure predicates.

notify.label: Real Unix datagram notifier and self subprocess
notify.qualification_limit: Real pathname/abstract Unix datagrams and process environment are exercised. No external systemd daemon participates; timeout and scheduling behavior remain runtime obligations.
